module.name: BNK Gateway Extension (IPAM)
module.description: Creates F5BnkGateway resource for IPAM integration with Gateway API.

required.reason: FLO must be deployed to install F5BnkGateway CRD and IPAM controller

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

optional.name: namespace
optional.description: Namespace for the F5BnkGateway (typically the gateway namespace)

optional.name: ipv4_cidr_range
optional.description: IPv4 CIDR range for IPAM allocation (e.g., 192.168.17.0/24)

optional.name: ipv6_cidr_range
optional.description: IPv6 CIDR range for IPAM allocation

optional.name: default_network
optional.description: Default network name for IP allocation
